{{Top|leg}}
'''Kyrf''' was a [[Liquor/Legends|liquor]] made by distilling and fermenting the [[kyrf]] fruit native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korbin]]. When fermented, kyrf liquor was very flavorful and potent to [[Human/Legends|Humans]], whom were very prone to its intoxicating effects. Korbin's indigenous [[scrub lizard]]s were immune to intoxication by kyrf. Korbinites, who were mostly human, were largely kyrf-addicts.
